onboarding.title: Build App
onboarding.body: Describe an app in plain language and the AI builds it — installed right onto your desktop.

onboarding.title: Refine it
tips: Use ✏️ Revise to add a feature to an installed app.
Open Spec ▾ to edit the spec, then 🪄 Consolidate to rebuild coherently.
Your data is kept across revises and consolidates.
Replay this intro anytime from ⚙️ settings.
